title: Best Crossbody Bag (2026)
summary: The guide highlights the top anti‑theft and travel‑ready crossbody bags for 2026.
method: Selected products were chosen from the cited sources, prioritizing those mentioned by more than one site. The list includes Travelon Crossbody, Lululemon Everywhere Belt Bag, Lululemon All Night Festival Bag Micro, Pacsafe CitySafe CX, and Baggallini Modern Pocket.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

products.name: Travelon Crossbody Anti-Theft Bag
why: The Travelon Crossbody earned the top spot as “Best Overall” in the anti‑theft bag list from rd.com.
It features locking zippers, RFID blocking, and anti‑slash materials tested by a product testing team.
products.desc: The Travelon Crossbody is an anti‑theft bag with locking zippers, RFID blocking, and slash‑resistant construction. It does not have a detachable strap.
products.benefit: Picture a commuter who needs a secure bag for daily travel. The Travelon Crossbody keeps credit cards safe with RFID blocking and protects belongings with slash‑resistant material. It outperforms other picks in overall security, as it earned the best overall rating. The catch: it is heavier than some lighter‑weight options.
products.skip_if: You prefer a very lightweight bag
products.amazon_listing: Travelon Anti-Theft Metro Convertible Small Crossbody Bag

products.name: Lululemon Everywhere Belt Bag
why: Featured as the best athleisure crossbody bag for travel in Women’s Health.
It offers a large capacity and is designed for active use.
products.desc: The Lululemon Everywhere Belt Bag is a large, adjustable belt bag designed for travel and athleisure use. It does not have a detachable strap.
products.benefit: Picture a runner who needs a hands‑free bag for workouts and city strolls. The Everywhere Belt Bag provides ample space and adjustable fit, making it ideal for active lifestyles. It wins over the Travelon Crossbody in terms of size and comfort for athleisure wear. The catch: it lacks RFID protection.

products.name: Lululemon All Night Festival Bag Micro
why: Reviewed as the best crossbody bag in the 2026 Lululemon Curved Crossbody Bag 3l review.
It is water‑repellent and has a quick‑access magnetic closure.
products.desc: The Lululemon All Night Festival Bag Micro is a compact, water‑repellent crossbody bag with a magnetic closure and exterior zippered pocket. It does not have a detachable strap.
products.benefit: Picture a festival attendee who needs a small, hands‑free bag to keep essentials safe. The All Night Festival Bag Micro offers a quick magnetic closure and water‑repellent surface, making it ideal for outdoor events. It outshines larger bags in portability but is smaller than the Travelon Crossbody. The catch: its size limits storage.
products.skip_if: You need a large capacity bag
products.amazon_listing: lululemon All Night Festival Bag Micro 2L

verdict.line: Picture a traveler who needs a secure, hands‑free bag for city tours and airport transfers. The Travelon Crossbody offers locking zippers, RFID blocking, and slash‑resistant material, making it the safest choice among the picks. Its main catch is that it is heavier than some lighter‑weight options.
